reviews.classification: dated proposal/audit palette with later authority or implementation qualification
reviews.disposition: V1–V29 preserve the user's interest in Vivid framing and Proto23 discovery/flow as a palette, not implementation proof or a replacement look owner. Fresh-browser default versus stored preference, category versus rarity, semantic colors plus non-hue cues, world/time accents, reduced motion and optional sound remain useful separately. Post-settlement anchored deltas, read-respecting logs, once-per-discovery markers and stable panel/focus/scroll positions must not change gameplay or replay on reload. Compression retains different tools/outcomes/thresholds/stop reasons and separates historical event preview from opening the current subject. Corc tooltip chronology remains unresolved, not a rejected-final design claim. Tiny spatial scenes, slip/response/landing and actor reactions can use real state without a new physics/map/companion engine or a hidden reaction-time demand. The later round explicitly retires the old 1366 viewport gate for current desktop targets; saved ACT NOW means documentation, not delivered effects or defaults.

Root engine matching ER3/ER9/MC35–37/AD39 rows inspected only. No external API browsing, installed-state verification, code fixes or rerun of historical probes.

reviews.classification: dated proposal/audit palette with later authority or implementation qualification
reviews.disposition: ER9-F1–F14, M1–M5, R1–R10, C1–C8 and A1–A5 retain synthetic source findings distinct from ordinary runtime reachability. Pre-stringify nonfinite/DTO loss, post-durable render failure and asynchronous import overlap are conditional risks, not proven current save corruption or double reward. Intended integer uniformity requires a caller policy before changing the measured round-based distribution. Local-life jump versus split difference was documented observation-based policy, not owed backpay; scheduler partition comparison must resubmit unspent time and match changing contexts. Tiny fullness drift, locale sort differences and formatter mutation do not establish actual current downstream wrong outcomes or justify an engine rewrite. The 63 literal Math.random sites are 24 cosmetic,36 gameplay and3 injectable defaults at that snapshot, not63 unconditional draws. Later Lane E reports seeded gameplay migration and a throwing combat-math default; preserve that supersession instead of treating the opening RNG inventory as current. Its lazy stream compatibility and canonical replay claim remain attributed lane evidence, not a freshly run whole-game replay here. Important code collision: ER9-local proposed MC35=integer distribution, MC36=commit phase versus notification failure, MC37=mutating read-only helpers. Root-palette MC35=retcon integrity, MC36=instance ID drift and MC37=crossover double apply. Cite ER9-A2/A3/A5 or qualified ER9-local names rather than silently aliasing these unrelated root codes. reviews.classification: dated proposal/audit palette with later authority or implementation qualification
reviews.disposition: ER3-T1–T16 and N1–N5 are dated options with inferred costs, not benchmarks, installed capability or current package specifications. AD39 supersedes its no-host-selected conclusion with Electron plus web; the Tauri/PWA comparisons remain useful historical tradeoffs. Runtime transpilation is distinct from checking; include is not an import firewall. Browser context isolation is distinct from frozen served bytes; same-context same-origin tabs exercise shared writer exclusion. Async storage must await actual commit before publication, and OPFS plus IndexedDB do not become one transaction. Worker/shell/throttling settings cannot guarantee sleep/exit execution or choose offline policy. Cosmetic signals/templates/islands must consume published projections without a second gameplay store; WASM and shared buffers require measured kernel/copy benefit. Compression is a codec/compatibility choice, not semantic durability; origin persistence is not backup. Exact bounded integers, decimal economics and approximate extreme magnitudes remain distinct domains. Steam release, host QA and real migration proofs stay separate; no new dependencies, external research, installation or benchmark is authorized by preserving this palette.
